summary: A personal in-office attendance compliance application with interactive calendar tracking, configurable day-per-period targets, and future planning. It includes a web frontend and a persistent API-backed data store.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace contains no application source, manifests, or Azure Functions configuration.

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Attendance Compliance API.
questions.answer: Create and update attendance policies with X required office days over a Y-week period; record office days; retrieve calendar and compliance summaries; create future attendance plans; compare planned and actual compliance over time.
questions.rationale: Distilled from the user's requested attendance entry, calendar tracking, compliance monitoring, and planning mode.
questions.recommendedChoice: Create and update attendance policies with X required office days over a Y-week period; record office days; retrieve calendar and compliance summaries; create future attendance plans; compare planned and actual compliance over time.
